summary: Frontend testing for Smart Investing external integration. 14/15 acceptance criteria pass. One bug: Desktop header nav 'Smart Investing' is a react-router NavLink (anchor without target='_blank' / rel='noopener'); requirement asks for <a target='_blank'>. Mobile menu, hero pill, hero CTA, footer, featured section, search results, category external handoff and product redirect all working as specified. Backend /api/products?category=smart-investing returns 4 expected products.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='nav-smart-investing' is rendered via react-router NavLink. It renders as <a href='https://wealth-unlock-3.emergent.host/'> but WITHOUT target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Requirement explicitly: 'Header nav Smart Investing is an <a> with target=_blank to the external URL'. Clicking it would either cause a same-tab navigation or trigger react-router internal route attempt. Gold styling is present (isActive class kicks in because to is an absolute URL). Fix: in desktop nav map, branch on n.external like the mobile menu does — render a plain <a target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'> for external items (keep data-testid). Should also force the gold class explicitly for n.featured so it stays gold regardless of active state.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/Header.jsx desktop <nav>: when n.external, render <a href={n.to} target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer' data-testid={...}> instead of <NavLink>. Apply text-gold class when n.featured.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx desktop NAV uses NavLink for all entries — external URLs require <a target=_blank>. Mobile menu already handles this correctly; mirror that logic in desktop nav.
NavLink with absolute URL in 'to' relies on react-router internal behavior. Better to use plain <a> for external links to avoid hidden routing side effects.
Consider also adding gold styling explicitly to featured nav item (independent of isActive).

rca of the issue: Header.jsx line 60-75 maps NAV through <NavLink to={n.to}> for every item. When n.external is true (Smart Investing), the NavLink is rendered with the external URL as `to` but does NOT pass target/rel. The mobile menu code path (lines 110-127) already branches on n.external and renders a plain <a target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'>. The desktop branch needs the same treatment. Reproduction: visit homepage on desktop, inspect [data-testid='nav-smart-investing'] — tag=A, href=correct, target='' (empty). Mitigation: replicate the mobile menu's external branch in the desktop NAV map.
